verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local inference engine with desktop and mobile apps, so connecting to cloud providers within the same interface is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only covers running and serving local models. Its OpenAI-compatible endpoint is a local server it exposes, not a client connection to cloud providers, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can connect to cloud AI providers alongside local models within the same interface
